descriptionText:
*About Devfum*

Devfum is a forward-thinking technology company focused on delivering web development, AI, and extended reality (XR) solutions that redefine industries. At Devfum, we foster a collaborative environment where top talent can thrive. You will work on cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and enjoy opportunities for continuous learning and career growth. Join us and be part of a team shaping the future of digital innovation.

*Vision:* _“To be the world’s pioneering digital experience provider.”_

*Why Join Devfum?*

We offer an environment that fosters growth, learning, and work-life balance, ensuring that our employees feel valued and motivated.

* *Bi-Annual Salary Increments:* Recognizing your contributions regularly.
* *Clear Career Growth Roadmap:* Software Engineer → Senior Software Engineer → Engineering Manager.
* *Continuous Learning:* Access to paid courses to enhance your skills.
* *Daily Meals:* Enjoy complimentary lunch and tea/coffee.
* *Recreational Activities:* Monthly sports activities and annual company tours.

*Role Overview*

We are hiring a Mid-Level Software Engineer who is strong in TypeScript, has solid backend architecture and database experience, and has hands-on exposure to DevOps in real production environments.

This role sits between junior execution and senior delivery ownership. You will work under a Senior Software Engineer to own features end-to-end, mentor junior engineers, and support deployments. This is a role for a builder who thinks in terms of edge cases, data integrity, and failure scenarios — not just happy paths.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Own full features/modules from implementation to release. Design the approach before coding and ensure features are stable, tested, and production-ready.
* Design REST APIs with proper validation and error handling. Implement layered backend architectures (controllers, services, data access) and handle role-based access control.
* Build production-ready interfaces using React.js and Next.js. Handle client-side/server-side rendering and state management.
* Translate high-level user stories into clear tasks for junior engineers. Review PRs and guide juniors to reduce rework.
* Handle deployments to staging and production (Linux/Cloud — AWS/DigitalOcean), debug basic production issues, check logs, and manage environment variables.

*Required Qualifications*

* 1.5–3 years of real production experience. You must have shipped real features to production.
* Technical Stack (Non-Negotiable):
* *Primary Language:* TypeScript (large codebases, interfaces, generics, strict type safety ).
* *Frontend:* React.js, Next.js, component-based architecture.
* *Databases:* PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or MySQL with schema design, data modeling, and ORMs (Prisma, TypeORM, Mongoose).
* *Auth:* Supabase Auth, Firebase, Auth0, or NextAuth.
* *Integrations:* Third-party APIs (Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI), real-time features (WebSockets/Supabase Realtime), or cloud storage (AWS S3).

*Soft Skills & Mindset*

* You take responsibility for your code and decisions.
* You communicate clearly, ask questions early, and respect engineering processes.

*Work Schedule*

Standard Hours: 12:00 PM – 09:00 PM, Monday to Friday.

*Salary Range*

PKR 150,000 – PKR 250,000

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: Rs200,000.00 - Rs250,000.00 per month



Application Question(s):
* Kindly share your GitHub profile link

Education:
* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:
*  real production: 3 years (Preferred)

Location:
* Lahore (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

descriptionText:
*Role:* Senior Backend Engineer (Fintech Infrastructure)
*Location:* Remote (Pakistan preferred, overlap with US hours)
*Company:* Nostro (Cross-Border Payments Infrastructure)

*About Nostro (www.nostro.pk):*

Nostro is an American Company building modern financial infrastructure to enable individuals in emerging markets to receive international payments with lower fees, better FX rates, and higher reliability. We are starting with Pakistan and expanding globally.

*Role Overview:*

We are looking for a *Senior Backend Engineer* to design and build the core infrastructure powering Nostro’s payment systems, leading a team of 1-2 Engineers. This is a high-impact role responsible for developing systems that are *reliable, auditable, and scalable* from day one.

You will play a key role in shaping our architecture, particularly around *ledger systems, transaction processing, and integrations with banking and payment partners*.

*What You’ll Do*

* Design and build scalable backend systems for cross-border payments
* Architect and implement a *double-entry ledger system* to track all financial transactions
* Develop APIs for payments, balances, and transaction history
* Build systems for *idempotency, reconciliation, and fault tolerance*
* Integrate with third-party payment providers and banking APIs
* Ensure high reliability and consistency under failure conditions
* Collaborate on system architecture, database design, and security practices
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code

*What We’re Looking For*

* 4+ years of backend engineering experience (experience in fintech or payments systems preferred, including companies such as SadaPay, NayaPay, PayFast, or Safepay)
* Strong proficiency in at least one: Go, Java, Node.js, or Python

*Deep understanding of:*

* Distributed systems
* Database design (PostgreSQL preferred)
* API design (REST and/or event-driven systems)
* Experience building *high-reliability systems in production*
* Familiarity with:
* Message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)
* Caching systems (Redis)
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail

*Strong Plus If You Have*

* Experience working at or building systems similar to Payoneer, PayPal, or Wise
* Experience building: Ledger systems, Wallets or payment platforms, Marketplace payout systems
* Understanding of: ACH, SWIFT, or cross-border payment rails, FX conversion and settlement processes

*Compensation*

* *Salary: PKR 80,000/month to PKR 150,000/month*
* *Equity: 0.25% to 0.75% (4-year vesting, 1-year cliff*)

*Note:* In the event of termination without cause before the 12-month cliff, equity will vest on a pro-rata basis.

*What Success Looks Like*

* You build systems that are *financially correct, auditable, and resilient*
* Transactions are never duplicated, lost, or inconsistent
* The system scales reliably as transaction volume grows

*Why Join Nostro*

* Build core financial infrastructure from the ground up
* High ownership and impact in an early-stage US startup
* Opportunity to solve real problems in global payments
* Work closely with founders on technical and product decisions

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: Rs150,000.00 - Rs250,000.00 per month



Application Question(s):
* What is your experience in working in the Fintech Industry? 

Education:
* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:
* Fintech: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: Remote

title: Senior Software Engineer / Full Stack Developer
descriptionText:
*About the Role*

We are seeking a *highly skilled and self-driven Senior Software Engineer / Full Stack Developer* with deep expertise in *React*, *Next.js*, and *AWS DevOps*. This role requires someone who can both execute and lead — an engineer who thrives in fast-paced environments, takes ownership, and is passionate about building scalable, modern web applications.

As a senior member of our engineering team, you will be responsible for full-cycle product development — from system architecture and coding to deployment and team mentoring.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using *React* and *Next.js*
* Architect full-stack solutions and ensure best practices in performance, security, and scalability
* Drive DevOps workflows, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and deployment automation using *AWS*
* Lead technical discussions, code reviews, and guide junior developers
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and cross-functional teams to deliver impactful features
* Monitor and optimize application performance and infrastructure costs
* Proactively identify and resolve technical issues or roadblocks

*Requirements*

* *10+ years* of professional software development experience, ideally in a fast-paced or startup environment
* Strong proficiency in *React*, *Next.js*, JavaScript/TypeScript
* Deep experience with *AWS services* such as EC2, S3, Lambda, CloudFormation, CodePipeline, etc.
* Solid understanding of backend development (Node.js preferred) and RESTful API design
* Experience with databases (SQL/NoSQL), caching, and scalable architecture patterns
* Strong DevOps mindset — comfortable with CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and infrastructure automation
* Ability to lead and mentor a team, drive initiatives independently, and communicate effectively

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience with GraphQL and microservices
* Familiarity with containerization tools (Docker, ECS, Kubernetes)
* Exposure to Agile methodologies and version control systems (e.g., Git)

*What We Offer*

* Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
* Flexible work schedule and remote-first culture
* Opportunity to take full ownership of projects and shape technical direction
* A collaborative, engineering-driven culture

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From Rs400,000.00 per month



Application Question(s):
* What salary package are you expecting? (required to be considered for this opportunity)
* How soon can you join us?

Experience:
* Software Development: 10 years (Required)
* Nodejs: 5 years (Required)
* Nextjs: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

Hashlogics, a Lahore-based software development company, is expanding its team and looking for passionate Software Engineers willing to work on either JavaScript or Python to join our growing team.As a Software Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining robust applications, troubleshooting software issues, and collaborating with the team to deliver high-quality software solutions.
*Job Responsibilities:*

* Analyzed, identified, and resolved software issues to ensure optimal performance and functionality across both traditional and AI-driven applications.
* Wrote clean, maintainable, and scalable code for a variety of software solutions, including those integrating AI/ML models and third-party AI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Hugging Face, AWS AI services).
* Designed, developed, tested, and implemented RESTful APIs, including endpoints serving or consuming AI model predictions and outputs.
* Built responsive and user-focused applications using provided wireframes and detailed requirements, integrating AI features such as natural language processing, intelligent search, or recommendation systems.
* Worked on full-stack development leveraging the MERN stack and extended functionality with AI/ML tools where needed (e.g., chatbot integration, automated insights).
* Participated in sprint planning and execution to ensure timely and efficient delivery of features, including iterative deployment of AI-powered enhancements.
* Maintained comprehensive documentation for code, AI model integration workflows, training pipelines, API specifications, and project milestones.
* Collaborated with cross-functional teams—including data scientists and ML engineers—and communicated effectively with stakeholders to understand and meet product goals involving AI components.
* Contributed creative ideas and innovative AI-based solutions to improve user experience, team productivity, and product intelligence.

*Qualifications:*

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field.
* Minimum 2 years of professional experience in full-stack development, with at least 1 year involving AI tool integration or usage.
* Strong knowledge of the MERN stack and experience working with AI/ML frameworks or platforms (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, OpenAI API).
* Proven experience in building, deploying, and integrating APIs, including those that serve AI models or leverage cloud-based AI services.
* Excellent problem-solving skills with a strategic, data-driven, and detail-oriented approach.
* Effective communication and collaboration abilities within team environments, especially in cross-disciplinary settings involving AI/ML teams.

*Perks & Benefits:*

* Provident Fund
* Gym Allowance
* Annual Paid Leaves
* Health & Life Insurance

As a Senior Software Engineer – Full Stack (Frontend Focus), you’ll play a key role in building and scaling the next generation of applications at Acquisition.com. You’ll work across the stack, with a strong emphasis on crafting high-quality, performant, and intuitive user experiences using React and Next.js.

In our lean, high-performing environment, your contributions will directly impact company-wide operations. You’ll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into elegant, scalable, and user-centered applications.

We’re looking for an engineer who is passionate about frontend architecture, design systems, usability, and performance — while maintaining strong backend fundamentals to operate effectively as a full-stack developer. You care deeply about how things feel, not just how they function.

*Responsibilities*

* Design, build, and maintain scalable, high-performance web applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
* Lead the development of intuitive, responsive, and accessible user interfaces with a strong focus on user experience and usability.
* Architect and maintain frontend application structure, state management, and component libraries for long-term scalability.
* Collaborate closely with product and design to translate requirements and workflows into polished, user-centered solutions.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend Node.js–based APIs, microservices, and system integrations.
* Contribute to backend development where needed, including API design, data modeling, and integration work.
* Optimize applications for speed, performance, SEO, and cross-browser compatibility.
* Improve development workflows through automation, AI-powered tooling, and continuous refinement of engineering processes.
* Write high-quality, well-tested code with comprehensive unit and end-to-end test coverage, and actively participate in code reviews.

*Requirements*

* Strong full-stack development experience with an emphasis on frontend engineering using React and Next.js.
* Deep understanding of modern frontend architecture, performance optimization, accessibility, and responsive design principles.
* Proficiency in TypeScript and modern JavaScript ecosystems.
* Adequate backend experience with Node.js, API design, and system integration to operate effectively as a full-stack developer.
* Experience designing and maintaining scalable, secure, and reliable applications.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Vercel and AWS, CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, and observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog.
* Strong understanding of state management, component-driven development, and design systems.
* Experience with agent-driven development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code).
* Commitment to testing, documentation, and engineering best practices.
* Ability to balance thoughtful architecture with rapid iteration in a fast-paced environment.
* *5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience operating at a senior level.*

*Results*

* Deliver polished, production-ready frontend applications that power Acquisition.com’s growth.
* Build intuitive, responsive, and accessible user experiences that drive adoption and usability.
* Maintain performant applications that scale without sacrificing reliability.
* Seamlessly integrate frontend systems with backend services and APIs.
* Contribute to a high bar for code quality, testing, and deployment practices.
* Reduce technical debt and improve development velocity through sound engineering decisions and automation.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer / Architect
descriptionText:
*About BSL*

Bhayani Securities (BSL) is one of the most established brokerage houses on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. We’re currently rebuilding our technology stack as a *tech-first* brokerage, with in-house engineering, modern platforms, and heavy use of AI tooling in our workflow.

*Role Summary*

We are hiring a *Senior Full-Stack Engineer*. This is a senior, individual-contributor role with architectural responsibility: you will define the technical direction, make key trade-offs, and deliver robust, production-grade systems.

*Key Responsibilities*

*End-to-end application development*

* Design and build multi-surface applications (web, mobile, desktop) for client and internal use.
* Implement and maintain back-end services in *Node.js* with *PostgreSQL* as the primary database.
* Build modern front-end interfaces with *React*, based on Figma designs from the UI team.
* Translate product requirements into clear technical tasks and ship features in small, reliable increments.

*Systems architecture & integration*

* Design application architecture suitable for *real-time, data-heavy financial workflows* and multi-user environments.
* Define and maintain clean API contracts between applications and the OMS / market-data systems, working with the existing FIX/OMS development team.
* Ensure the system design supports future extensions (new modules, analytics features, additional channels) without rewrites.

*On-prem infrastructure & DevOps*

* Deploy, run, and monitor applications on *local, in-office servers* (Linux-based).
* Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and repeatable deployments.
* Configure and manage PostgreSQL in production: schema design, indexing, migrations, backups, and recovery drills.
* Implement logging, metrics, and alerting so issues can be detected and diagnosed quickly.
* Handle releases, environment configuration, and versioning across web, mobile, and desktop builds.

*UI implementation & collaboration*

* Work closely with the design team: consume *Figma* files, give practical feedback, and implement pixel-accurate, responsive UIs.
* Ensure good UX under realistic constraints: latency, bandwidth, hardware limitations, and real user behaviour in a brokerage context.

*AI-enabled engineering & internal tools*

* Use *AI coding tools* (e.g. ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of your workflow to speed up development without compromising quality.
* Design and build *customer-facing features and tools* powered by LLM APIs (e.g. OpenAI) inside our web, mobile, and desktop products.

*Lifecycle ownership*

* Own your code in production: debugging, performance tuning, and iterative improvement.
* Plan and execute refactors when necessary to keep the codebase maintainable.
* Maintain technical documentation that’s concise and actually useful.

*Required Skills & Experience*

*Core engineering*

* 6+ years of professional experience as a full-stack engineer building production systems end-to-end.
* Strong command of *Node.js *for backend development.
* Strong command of *React* for front-end development (hooks, state management, routing, forms).
* Solid experience with *PostgreSQL*: schema design, query optimisation, indexing, migrations.
* Experience building *data-intensive, multi-user applications* with a focus on correctness and reliability.

*Platforms & deployment*

* Experience delivering *web applications* in production using React + Node.js back-ends.
* Experience building and shipping *mobile applications* (preferably with React Native, including App Store / Play Store releases).
* Experience packaging applications for *Windows desktop* users.
* Comfortable working with *Linux servers*, networking basics, reverse proxies, and SSL/TLS.
* Hands-on experience setting up *CI/CD pipelines* and automated testing for both front-end and back-end code.
* Experience implementing secure authentication, authorization, and basic application security best-practices.

*AI & automation*

* Daily, practical use of *AI coding tools* (ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) as part of your engineering process.

*Way of working*

* Able to work independently with high ownership: take a high-level requirement from the founder and drive it to production without micro-management.
* Comfortable operating in a founder-led environment where priorities can shift and we iterate quickly.
* Clear, concise communication in writing and in person; able to keep non-engineering stakeholders updated without over-explaining.

*Nice to Have*

(Not required, but a strong plus.)

* Experience in *brokerage, trading, market data, or fintech* systems.
* Experience with *on-premises* deployments in regulated or security-sensitive environments.
* Experience optimising systems for *low latency* and *high-throughput* event streams.

title: Full-Stack Mobile Application Engineer
descriptionText:
*About the Role*

We’re looking for a *full-stack mobile app engineer* with strong mobile development fundamentals and a heavier emphasis on the backend systems that power mobile features. You will work across the mobile stack—from application logic and data flows to the backend services, integrations, APIs, and cloud infrastructure that support the apps. Heavy focus on building secure and HIPAA compliant applications.

*Responsibilities:*

*Backend & Cloud Architecture (Primary Focus)*

* Design, implement, and maintain backend services, APIs, and system integration layers using *Node.js/Express*, *Python/FastAPI/Django*, or *Go/Gin*.
* Architect scalable, secure, and observable backend systems with a strong emphasis on *distributed design*, *fault tolerance*, and *high-availability patterns*.
* Build and maintain *serverless and cloud-native infrastructure* in *Azure*, including:
* Azure Functions
* Azure API Management
* Azure Cosmos DB
* Azure Event Grid / Service Bus
* Azure App Service
* Implement authentication, authorization, data protection, secure storage, and compliance-aligned backend workflows.
* Develop internal and external *REST/GraphQL APIs*, event-driven services, and *messaging-based integrations* using queues, topics, and pub/sub patterns.
* Build backend pipelines that support mobile clients (sync engines, data transformations, caching strategies, session management, telemetry ingestion).

*Mobile Engineering (Secondary but Significant Focus)*

* Build and maintain mobile applications using Javascript (React Native), Flutter, or native frameworks (Swift/Kotlin), with an emphasis on *application logic, data flows, and system interactions rather than UI-heavy work*.
* Implement mobile networking, offline sync, authentication flows, and secure client-side data patterns.
* Integrate third-party mobile services including: push notifications, analytics, payments, identity providers, and messaging platforms.

*Systems Quality & Collaboration*

* Ensure performance, reliability, observability, and operational readiness across backend and mobile systems.
* Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; contribute to CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates.
* Collaborate closely with product, design, and platform teams to plan features, system behavior, and long-term architecture.

*Required Qualifications:*

* *3+ years backend engineering experience* using Node.js, Python, Go, or similar, with strong understanding of API design, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud-native patterns.
* Experience with *mobile application development* (React Native, Flutter, Swift/Kotlin), focusing on application logic, networking, and backend integration.
* Strong understanding of *REST/GraphQL*, websockets, event-driven systems, and messaging queues.
* Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases (*Postgres, MongoDB, DynamoDB/Cosmos*), including schema design, indexing, and performance tuning.
* Solid understanding of *mobile networking*, secure data handling, and authentication/authorization flows.
* Experience with *Azure cloud services* or strong willingness to work extensively with Azure.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, testing frameworks, performance monitoring, and logging/observability tooling.

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Strong experience with *Azure serverless architecture*.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
* Experience with mobile app distribution (App Store, Google Play).
* Experience with mobile testing frameworks (Detox, Jest, XCTest, Espresso).
* Knowledge of Clean Architecture, MVVM, or similar patterns.
* Experience building real-time or event-driven features using Azure Event Grid or Service Bus.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: Rs180,000.00 - Rs250,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: DevOps Engineer
descriptionText:
*Job Purpose*

The DevOps Engineer is responsible for bridging the gap between development and operations teams to ensure fast, secure, reliable, and automated software delivery and infrastructure management.

*Key Responsibilities*

*1. CI/CD and Automation*

* Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI.
* Automate build, test, and deployment processes.
* Troubleshoot build and release failures.
* Maintain versioning and release management processes.

*2. Cloud and Infrastructure Management*

* Provision and manage infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or Cloud Formation.
* Ensure scalability, high availability, and disaster recovery readiness.
* Optimize cloud costs and performance.

*3. Containers and Orchestration*

* Build, manage, and secure Docker container images.
* Deploy and manage Kubernetes clusters and workloads.
* Support micro services-based architecture and service communication.

*4. Monitoring, Logging, and Security*

* Configure monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or Cloud-native monitoring.
* Analyze logs and resolve production incidents.
* Implement Develops and security best practices.
* Conduct vulnerability scanning and patch management.

*5. Collaboration and Documentation*

* Work closely with developers to resolve deployment and environment issues.
* Participate in incident response and on-call rotations.
* Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and architecture diagrams.

*Required Skills*

*Technical Skills*

* Strong Linux system administration
* Git and version control workflows
* CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance
* Docker and Kubernetes
* Cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
* Scripting in Bash or Python
* Networking fundamentals and security basics

*Soft Skills*

* Problem-solving mindset
* Clear communication
* Team collaboration
* Time and priority management

*Experience*

* *Mid Level DevOps Engineer:* 2–5 years

*Education*

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering recognized university or equivalent practical experience.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: Rs80,000.00 - Rs140,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
